entries.description: Initialize governance integrity lock framework and baseline hash registry.
Register math-physics boundary cleanup guidance as a governed documentation asset and retrieval annotation.
Register validator import-path tooling debt and temporarily canonicalize module-style global validation invocation in governance documentation.
Bootstrap the DB governance runtime gate, add DB-first instruction language, and record the runtime gate as a governed patch path.
Add the DB current-state runtime projection, expose the current-state query command, and record the remaining semantic runtime debt explicitly.
Add target-aware authority resolution to the DB governance runtime, surface live ownership decisions, and update the governed runtime documentation.
Add runtime patch-chain resolution, patch-gate preflight sequencing, and dependency-bound patch classification to the DB governance runtime.
Add debt runtime projection and debt-aware patch-gate preflight to the DB governance runtime, while preserving unresolved stale snapshot and deeper semantic debt.
Add the agent-facing runtime context capsule projection, expose the context-capsule command, and register the remaining capsule-compression debt explicitly.
Add an append-only governance event bus, emit governance-significant runtime events, and expose event query / emission commands.
Add a bounded governance event replay scaffold and diagnostic replay command while preserving registry authority.
Add a diagnostic replay/authority reconciliation surface that compares replayed governance state against registry authority without mutating authority files.
Add a DB snapshot freshness gate and freshness query command so stale indexed snapshots are explicit runtime state before DB-dependent allow/defer/block decisions.
Add a verified snapshot refresh procedure and explicit refresh metadata so the freshness gate can report the precise cause of stale DB state.
Separate projection freshness from runtime-only DB churn by persisting distinct source and runtime markers so decision logs and event writes no longer invalidate a freshly refreshed snapshot.
Expand DB governance runtime authority resolution from file-target lookup into semantic authority mapping and semantic patch-gate checks.
Reconcile the math registry runtime name to the canonical math source registry, update runtime validation surfaces, and record the deprecated legacy path as superseded.
Project the canonical RT core into the DB current-state capsule and surface governed debt blockers and historical residue as structured runtime records.

Introduce the dominant-domain linear/nonlinear binding principle, register the provisional induction and live queue entry, add the corresponding lexicon gaps, and synchronize the textbook clarification against RT_core precedence.
Establish RT_core as the unique primitive calculus, derive linear and nonlinear operational regimes from RT_core, and prohibit treating linearity or nonlinearity as an axiomatic floor.

Define RT_operational_regime as a derived continuation mode of RT_core, keep the regime family unnamed for now, register the term in the lexicon gap queue, and synchronize the textbook clarification and governance ledger.

Define Orientation as the organizational classifier of RT operational regimes, keep regime-family privilege out of scope, register the new classification term in the lexicon gap queue, and synchronize the textbook clarification and governance ledger.

Define the linear operational regime as an orientation-classified derived result of RT_core, keep linear-algebraic representation downstream of RT derivation, register the linear regime term in the lexicon gap queue, and synchronize the textbook clarification and governance ledger.

Define the nonlinear operational regime as an orientation-classified derived result of RT_core, keep nonlinear-algebraic representation downstream of RT derivation, register the nonlinear regime term in the lexicon gap queue, and synchronize the textbook clarification and governance ledger.

Define the governed boundary and transition between the derived linear and nonlinear RT operational regimes, keep L/NL change trace-bound to RT_core, register the boundary term in the lexicon gap queue, and synchronize the textbook clarification and governance ledger.

Define the mixed L/NL operational regime as a derived RT classification that permits coexistence only under explicit separation, keep the regime trace-bound to RT_core, register the mixed-regime term in the lexicon gap queue, and synchronize the textbook clarification and governance ledger.

Define operational regime selection as a deterministic RT classification process, keep selection repeatable and trace-bound to RT_core, register the selection term in the lexicon gap queue, and synchronize the textbook clarification and governance ledger.

Define A|E as the primitive affect/effect distinction condition and D(*|*) as its formal distinction-schema projection, register the term in the lexicon gap queue, and synchronize the textbook clarification and governance ledger.

Resolve repository stabilization defects by adding the Memory Tensor bootstrap alias, repairing the malformed economics traceability chain, correcting Appendix G and evidence references, and marking legacy RT root notation and the braid block as historical residue or deferred material.

Introduce the primitive affect/effect distinction projection algebra by formalizing ÃŽÂ _D as a projection operator from A|E to D(*|*), preserving the non-primitive status of D(*|*) and keeping RT_core unchanged.

Introduce the residue-governed continuation relation A ->r B as a governed process transformation, keep it distinct from symbolic rewrite, register the continuation term in the lexicon gap queue, and synchronize the textbook clarification and governance ledger.

Elevate continuation from residue-governed notation to a first-class continuation object C(A,B), bind A ->r B to that object, preserve the residue constraint, and synchronize the textbook, ledgers, lexicon, and source registry.

Quarantine four root-level cross-* registry and protocol artifacts into the canonical registry directory, repair the remaining bare cross-agent contradiction doc reference, and preserve the three open governance/runtime debts as explicit open items.

Define lawful continuation composition for C(A,B) and C(B,C), require shared-endpoint compatibility and residue/admissibility preservation, and synchronize the composition law across the textbook, registries, and governance ledger.

Define the identity continuation I(A)=C(A,A) and the admissibility conditions under which continuation exists or fails, then synchronize the identity law across the textbook, registries, lexicon, and governance ledger.

Define process equivalence for continuation expressions and introduce canonical continuation forms NF(C), then synchronize the relation and canonical form across the textbook, registries, lexicon, and governance ledger.

Define continuation reduction semantics as a governed transformation toward canonical form NF(C), preserve process equivalence, and synchronize the semantics across the textbook, registries, lexicon, and governance ledger.
Introduce the first concrete continuation reduction rules under ->red, preserve process equivalence, and synchronize the rules across the textbook, registries, lexicon, and governance ledger.

Define WF(C) as the well-formed continuation gate, constrain continuation composition and reduction to well-formed expressions, and synchronize the new continuation typing and domain-guard rules across the textbook, registries, lexicon, and governance ledger.

Define explicit domain typing for continuation expressions across meta, affect/effect, projection, continuation, observation, and operational-regime layers, and synchronize the typing guards across the textbook, registries, lexicon, and governance ledger.

Define lawful typed transitions from the affect/effect domain into the projection domain, requiring explicit invocation of ÃŽÂ _D and forbidding direct collapse from A|E to D(*|*), while synchronizing the transition rules across the textbook, registries, lexicon, and governance ledger.

Strengthen continuation composition by requiring endpoint compatibility, admissibility, residue propagation, and typed-domain compatibility, while synchronizing the guards across the textbook, registries, lexicon, and governance ledger.

Define continuation failure as a marked diagnostic state âŠ¥C for inadmissible composition, reduction, or typed transition outcomes, while preserving RT_core and recording undefined normalization semantics, and synchronize the failure semantics across the textbook, registries, lexicon, analysis queue, and governance ledger.

Classify continuation failure into endpoint, type, admissibility, and residue subclasses, keep recovery explicitly deferred, and synchronize the failure-classification semantics across the textbook, registries, lexicon, and governance ledger.

Define the ordered evaluation pipeline for continuation expressions, ensuring failure classification occurs before composition is admitted and reduction remains gated by well-formedness, typing, typed transitions, endpoint compatibility, admissibility, and residue propagation.

Document the minimal continuation reduction algorithm after EVAL_024, including identity reduction, lawful composition contraction, classified failure handling, and partial-NF fallback while keeping termination, confluence, and normalization taxonomy deferred.
Define Partial Normal Form semantics, distinguish pNF from NF and continuation failure, and classify reduction outcomes canonically without changing RT_core.
Define the canonical reduction trace object produced by REDUCE_025, including trace-step semantics, halt reasons, and outcome-linked diagnostic records without changing RT_core.
Define reduction trace equivalence and canonical trace normalization, add comparison semantics for Trace(C), and preserve outcome and halt-classification identity across lawful trace comparisons.
Define local confluence conditions, reduction branch objects, joinability, and critical pair classification for divergent lawful reductions while leaving global confluence and termination deferred.

Define reduction determinism conditions, reduction priority semantics, choice function selection, and deterministic continuation class boundaries while leaving termination and global confluence deferred.
Define bounded termination conditions, reduction measure semantics, strict progress, and termination classes while leaving universal termination and global confluence deferred.

Define bounded canonical-form uniqueness modulo process equivalence, add canonical representatives and normal-form equivalence classes, and keep uniqueness bounded by deterministic reduction and finite termination while leaving global confluence and universal uniqueness deferred.

Define an abstract reduction complexity measure, its delta semantics, reduction cost accumulation, and bounded complexity classes while keeping complexity distinct from runtime, syntax size, and the termination measure.

Establish the first bounded confluence theorem for bounded continuation classes that already satisfy local confluence, determinism, termination, and canonical uniqueness, while leaving universal confluence and Church-Rosser deferred.

Define the canonical reduction strategy for lawful candidate selection after EVAL_024, including the candidate set, strategy ordering, admissibility filtering, and bounded strategy classes while leaving strategy correctness and universal optimality deferred.

Establish bounded correctness of the canonical reduction strategy for admissible continuation classes, preserving process equivalence, canonical outcomes, bounded determinism, and bounded confluence assumptions while leaving universal correctness and optimality deferred.

Introduce recursive continuation semantics as the first expressiveness extension after bounded strategy correctness, with an explicit recursive guard and depth boundary; bounded unfolding, pNF fallback, and classified recursive failure are preserved while recovery, sigma_RT, and operational-regime execution remain deferred.

Introduce higher-order continuation semantics in which continuations themselves become admissible operands for lawful construction, transformation, and composition while preserving bounded semantics, existing reduction behavior, and RT_core invariance.

Establish bounded correctness conditions for higher-order continuation semantics, including HC(C), T(C), and Lift(C), while preserving bounded strategy correctness, canonical outcomes, and RT_core invariance.

Introduce bounded fixed-point semantics for continuation expressions, defining Fix(C), ÃŽÂ¦(C), EvalÃŽÂ¦(C), CandFix(C), and ClassFix while preserving bounded reduction behavior and RT_core invariance; existence, uniqueness, admissibility, and correctness remain deferred.

Project the semantic authority graph and claim-registry/support claim reasoning into the DB current-state capsule, expose claim-evidence link coverage explicitly, and resolve DEBT_DB_GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME_STATE_002 in the governed debt registry.
Surface bounded replay reconciliation coverage in the live current-state and context-capsule projections, keep replay diagnostic-only, and resolve DEBT_DB_GOVERNANCE_RUNTIME_EVENT_REPLAY_006.

Introduce bounded fixed-point admissibility conditions for continuation expressions, defining AdmFix(C), BoundPhi(C), InvPhi(C), and FailAdmFix(C) while preserving bounded candidate semantics and RT_core invariance; correctness, uniqueness, admissibility as universal theorem, and recovery remain deferred.

Introduce bounded fixed-point correctness conditions for admissible continuation expressions, defining CorrectFix(C), ThmCorrectFix, and FailCorrectFix(C) while preserving admissibility layering and RT_core invariance; uniqueness, universal existence, and recovery remain deferred.

Introduce bounded fixed-point uniqueness conditions for correct continuation fixed points, defining UniqueFix(C), EqClassFix(C), and FailUniqueFix(C) while preserving correctness layering and RT_core invariance; universal uniqueness, universal existence, and recovery remain deferred.

Define bounded interaction between recursive continuation semantics and fixed-point semantics, introducing RecFix(C), AlignRecFix(C), DivRecFix(C), and FailRecFix(C) while preserving RT_core invariance; universal recursive convergence, recursive reachability, recovery, and sigmaRT remain deferred.

Consolidate the governed RT Calculus into RT Calculus v1.0, indexing the existing primitive, typing, evaluation, reduction, continuation, fixed-point, and governance surfaces without adding new objects or theorems; RT_core remains unchanged.
